## README.md
# Field boundaries for Luxembourg

Provides 87997 official field boundaries from Luxembourg.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Administration des services techniques de l'agriculture.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Administration des services techniques de l'agriculture](https://agriculture.public.lu/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC0 (public domain)
- **Projection:** EPSG:2169 (Luxembourg 1930 / Gauss)

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/luxembourg/luxembourg.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/lu/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/luxembourg/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/luxembourg/luxembourg.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property | **Data Type** | Description |
|----------|---------------|-------------|
| id       | string        | FLIK-id     |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-11-10 from https://data.public.lu/fr/datasets/r/b4ae6690-7e4c-4454-8b60-9fa33ba6a61b .
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.7.0
